text:
Sam R.: Hey team, my March 31 paystub shows CA state tax withheld. I moved to WA and updated my home address back in Jan. My net is ~8% lower than expected. Can someone check why WA (no state tax) wasn’t applied?
Chris (Payroll): sorry to hear that. Can you share payrun id and stub? quick check: were you on US payroll with state recorded as WA? :thinking_face: 
Sam R.: payrun PR-20260331-1012. Stub: https://files.redwood.example/stubs/sam-0331.png. My payroll profile shows mailing addr WA, but the old hire record might still have CA on file. I thought People Ops updated it when I moved remote.
Lina (People Ops): Sam I pulled your change request #HR-2147, it shows address update submitted 2026-01-12 but the state field was blank on the HR form. We routed to Payroll for verification but maybe never confirmed. My bad for not flagging.
Chris (Payroll): ok here's what I see in the payroll system: employee.tax_state = CA, employee.work_state = WA, payroll.run PR-20260331 pulled tax_state value (CA). That triggered CA SDI and CA PIT withholdings. Papaya processed the run with CA tax jurisdiction.
TaxBot: Automated notice: PR-20260331 processed · taxes withheld: Federal, CA State · special flag: mismatched_work_vs_tax_state.
Dana-Fin: If CA tax applied in error we offer two remedies: 1) off-cycle reversal of withheld amounts + reissue net (preferred for employee convenience), 2) employee files CA refund after year-end using nonresident return (more work for employee). Off-cycle affects cashflow; need Finance sign-off.
Sam R.: I definitely want option 1. I don’t want to file refunds myself. 
Lina (People Ops): Sam approved. Chris, can Payroll run the reversal? Also please patch the HR->Payroll handoff to require tax_state filled.
Chris (Payroll): will do. Steps: a) update employee.tax_state -> WA in payroll; b) create Papaya ticket TG-3319 to reverse CA withhold lines on PR-20260331 and post a correcting off-cycle deposit for net withheld taxes; c) create accounting memo for the reversal so GL matches; d) log for W-2 impact (we may need W-2C if year-end already filed).
Chris (Payroll): filed ticket TG-3319. Papaya ETA for reversal entries: 2 business days. Off-cycle deposit scheduled if reversal accepted. I'll also attach the corrected stub.
TaxBot: Ticket TG-3319 acknowledged by Papaya support · owner: R. Kapoor · expected response by 2026-04-02 14:00 UTC.
Dana-Fin: Finance approves off-cycle reversal and reimbursement for CA withheld payroll taxes. Please mark cost center and record temporary liability impact.
Lina (People Ops): I’ll update the HR change request workflow: make tax_state mandatory and add a follow-up checklist to confirm payroll ingestion. Assigning to me and Ops-SRE to add an alert if work_state != tax_state.
Sam R.: thanks. timeline? I’d like the funds back before I pay rent next month.
Chris (Payroll): aiming reversal posted by 2026-04-02 and reissue same day. If Papaya delays we'll escalate. I’ll DM you when processed and share corrected stub.
Dana-Fin: note for year-end: if reversal spans tax year boundaries we may still need to issue W-2C. TaxOps will advise closer to year-end.
Sam R.: appreciated. Please also confirm my address and W-4 info is correct for federal/state. I uploaded a scanned proof to #people-ops earlier.
Lina (People Ops): got it, I see the scan and will confirm once payroll update completes. Closing loop once reversal posts. :white_check_mark:
